products.body:
Unlock the secrets to defending one of the most dangerous and common submissions in No-Gi Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu—the Guillotine—with Gordon Ryan, the most accomplished No-Gi competitor in the history of the sport.

  • With years of experience under the guidance of John Danaher, Gordon has developed an unparalleled skill set in both executing and teaching BJJ techniques.
  • In this highly anticipated instructional, Gordon dives deep into the art of defending against the guillotine choke, providing you with the tools and strategies to maintain position, escape, and turn the tables on your opponent.
  • Maintaining Key Positions: Learn how to protect yourself and avoid falling into bad positions when facing a guillotine attack.
  • Progressing Your Own Position: Discover how to use your defensive reactions as opportunities to advance your own position and dominate your opponent.
  • Early Escapes: Get ahead of the submission and learn how to escape early before the guillotine becomes fully locked in.
  • Late Escapes: Master the techniques and strategies needed to escape from even the tightest, most threatening guillotines.
  • Whether you’re a beginner or an advanced practitioner, this instructional will help you refine your ability to defend against one of the highest percentage submissions in No-Gi BJJ

What Will You Learn?

Unlock the secrets to defending one of the most dangerous and common submissions in No-Gi Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu—the Guillotine—with Gordon Ryan, the most accomplished No-Gi competitor in the history of the sport. With years of experience under the guidance of John Danaher, Gordon has developed an unparalleled skill set in both executing and teaching BJJ techniques. In this highly anticipated instructional, Gordon dives deep into the art of defending against the guillotine choke, providing you with the tools and strategies to maintain position, escape, and turn the tables on your opponent.

Whether you’re a beginner or an advanced practitioner, this instructional will help you refine your ability to defend against one of the highest percentage submissions in No-Gi BJJ. Learn the most effective defensive concepts and techniques that will keep you safe in any situation where the guillotine may arise. With Gordon’s guidance, you’ll gain not just knowledge of escapes, but an overall mastery of positional control, making you a more well-rounded grappler in any scenario.

What You’ll Learn:

  • Maintaining Key Positions: Learn how to protect yourself and avoid falling into bad positions when facing a guillotine attack.
  • Progressing Your Own Position: Discover how to use your defensive reactions as opportunities to advance your own position and dominate your opponent.
  • Early Escapes: Get ahead of the submission and learn how to escape early before the guillotine becomes fully locked in.
  • Late Escapes: Master the techniques and strategies needed to escape from even the tightest, most threatening guillotines.
  • In-Depth Analysis: Gordon Ryan provides step-by-step breakdowns of the most common guillotine variations, ensuring you have the knowledge to defend against all of them.
  • Expert Teaching: With Gordon Ryan’s ability to explain complex concepts in a digestible and effective way, you’ll understand not just how to defend, but why each technique works.

Key Features:

  • Taught by Gordon Ryan, the most successful No-Gi competitor in the world
  • Multiple Defensive Strategies for defending and escaping the guillotine
  • Focused on early and late escapes, ensuring you're prepared at any stage of the submission
  • Progressive Instruction: Build your skills step-by-step for a solid foundation in guillotine defense
  • Learn to maintain strong positioning and turn defense into offense
  • High-Quality Video Instruction that makes complex techniques easy to understand and apply

Perfect For:

  • No-Gi BJJ practitioners of all levels
  • Grapplers looking to add valuable defenses to their game
  • Anyone who wants to become proficient at escaping and countering guillotine submissions
  • Students who want to train with one of the most accomplished instructors in the sport

Take Control of Your Guillotine Defense
In Pillars of Defense: Guillotines, Gordon Ryan empowers you with everything you need to make the guillotine a submission you can avoid, escape from, and turn to your advantage. Whether you’re rolling in the gym or facing high-level opponents in competition, this instructional will give you the confidence to handle guillotines with ease.

Get ready to defend, dominate, and add another layer of sophistication to your No-Gi game!

products.title: The Pillars of Defense: Turtle & Front Headlock Escapes by Gordon Ryan
products.body:
This is your chance to learn from 3-Time ADCC Champion Gordon Ryan as he shares all his secrets around escaping turtle and front headlocks 

  • Gordon is one of the most detailed and thorough teachers in grappling, with incredible systematic attention to detail.
  • Use peak outs, 4 points, sitting to half guard, and more to get away from front headlocks.
  • Roll to guard and escape from turtle with Gordon’s tips for staying safe and preventing hooks so you can get away from their control while still staying safe from submission threats.
  • These are the same systems that Gordon uses to build his defensive skills as a foundation for his entire game.
  • Watch as Gordon rolls in the gym from these same positions and then breaks down the footage to explain the techniques in action.                                                                                                                              


Build Your Game On A Strong Foundation Of Escapes With These Systems For Escaping Turtle Position And Front Headlocks With ADCC Champion & No-Gi Grappling Superstar Gordon “The King” Ryan

Checkout Sample!

What Will You Learn?

Learn all of the most effective systematic ways to escape from the turtle position and the front headlocks from the best no-gi grappler on Earth, Gordon “The King” Ryan. With hours of content on how you can clear hooks, prevent strangles, stop opponents who are getting behind you, and more on this 8-volume set.

Gordon Ryan is one of the best no-gi grapplers in history, and is still building his legacy with a path of submission success. With 3 ADCC World Championships & an IBJJF World No-Gi Championship, most focus on Gordon’s offense but he believes the true way to build your foundation is improvement on the ability to defend and escape. Now you can see how he approaches this important skill from these common no-gi positions.

Use shoulder rolls, stand ups, 4 point positions, and more to get out from turtle, as Gordon teaches you how to stay safe in what could be a dangerous position as you expose your back. Instead, see all the ways you can use these escapes to start setting up submission threats as you move back to guard and start launching your offense.

Work out of front headlocks with the confidence to not give up your neck or give up your back with Gordon’s advice. Use peek outs, guard pulls, rolls, and more as he explains how to defend yourself in this common problematic position without letting them attack with guillotines, darces, and more.

products.title: The Pillars Of Defense Bundle by Gordon Ryan
products.body:
The complete The Pillars Of Defense series by Gordon Ryan in one bundle: 9 courses, 66 volumes.

  • All 9 courses of the The Pillars Of Defense series, each one complete with every volume
  • The same method applied position by position, so each course builds on the others
  • Watch on the BJJ Fanatics site or app, as many times as you need


What Will You Learn?

Gordon Ryan built the The Pillars Of Defense series one course at a time, each one focused on a single part of the game. This bundle puts all 9 together so you can study the series as one connected system.

Inside you will find: The Pillars of Defense: Back Escapes, The Pillars of Defense: Turtle & Front Headlock Escapes, The Pillars of Defense: Pin Escapes - Defensive to Offensive Cycles, Pillars of Defense: Upper Body Joint Lock Escapes, Pillars of Defense: Strangle Escapes, The Pillars Of Defense: Leg Lock Escapes and Counter Locks, The Pillars of Defense: Leg Locks to Guard Passing, Pillars of Defense: Leg Locks to Back Takes and Pillars of Defense: Guillotines.

products.title: Pillars of Defense: Strangle Escapes by Gordon Ryan
products.body:
Find The Way Out Of Near-Certain Submission Doom As Gordon “The King” Ryan - The Greatest No-Gi Grappler On Earth - Shows The Right Way To Escape Out Of An Encyclopedia Of Strangle Holds  

  • Gordon “The King” Ryan is a multiple-time ADCC champion who is the most dominant and technical no-gi grappler on Earth, and this is your chance to learn his pin escaping!
  • Use technique and conceptual lessons to escape from front triangles, wrong way triangles, rear triangles, reverse triangles, and side triangles
  • Gordon breaks down early escapes, late escapes, and ways out of strangles that really work against elite competitors
  • Solve submission dilemmas as Gordon explains the right way to prevent joint locks and strangles in the same position
  • See actual rolling footage from the gym as Gordon puts this system into action and then breaks down exactly what he was doing so you can see the techniques in motion                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               


Find The Way Out Of Near-Certain Submission Doom As Gordon “The King” Ryan - The Greatest No-Gi Grappler On Earth - Shows The Right Way To Escape Out Of An Encyclopedia Of Strangle Holds

Check Out The Trailer!

What Will You Learn?

Gordon “The King” Ryan, the greatest no-gi grappler on Earth, is back with BJJ Fanatics to show all of the most effective ways to escape from all of the most effective and common strangles in jiu-jitsu. Across 8-volumes, learn how you can master early and late defenses that will help you escape from triangles, guillotines, darces, and more strangles you will encounter on the mat.

In step-by-step fashion, you will get a guide on how you can get out of these holds and counter your way into better positions. Gordon shows you how to use techniques with maximum leverage, explaining not just what to do but why you are doing it, as he goes through each of the major strangles - broken down by upper body strangles (like a guillotine) and lower body strangles (like a triangle). 

Learn why you can only consider yourself a true master of a move once you understand the defense as Gordon explains how the escapes of each move influences the offense (and vice verse). 

Watch these systems in action as Gordon rolls live in the gym and then breaks down each roll - for you to see what he’s doing and hear why he’s doing it. With 8 volumes full of material for you to study, this offers you a full encyclopedia of all the major strangles that you’ll need to escape from, with full explanations from Gordon Ryan on how you should be building your way out from any of them.
